name: Game Folder
description: Finds the installed Warcraft III: if the configured folder doesn't open, offers the installs found in the usual places (the Windows default; Steam, Lutris and Wine prefixes on Linux).

game.askForFolder.description: At start, offer the Warcraft III installs found when game.installDir doesn't open. Off: never asked; "Game Data: Choose Warcraft III Folder…" still works.
